module purpose: neorv32_twi is a bus-programmed two-wire serial controller: a bus write at address bit 2 = '0' sets enable, prescaler select, clock divider and clock-stretch enable, and a write at address bit 2 = '1' pushes an 11-bit command word into a TX FIFO; a counter divides a selected clkgen_i enable into a bit tick, a four-phase generator times each bit, and a state machine drives SDA/SCL sequences and nine-bit shift transfers on twi_sda_o and twi_scl_o while sampling twi_sda_i and twi_scl_i, writes each received frame into an RX FIFO, returns settings, status and RX data on bus reads, and raises irq_o when enabled and idle with the TX FIFO empty.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, prescaler select, clock divider, clock-stretch enable) taken from bus write data at address bit 2 = '0'
11-bit command word (data byte, acknowledge bit, operation code) pushed into the TX FIFO by a bus write at address bit 2 = '1'
command fetch: TX FIFO pop and load of the operation code and transmit frame when the engine is idle, a command is waiting and a tick occurs
bit tick: the clkgen_i bit selected by ctrl.prsc counted up to ctrl.cdiv while enabled
four-phase bit timing advanced on each tick and held by clock stretching
bus sequences and nine-bit shift transfers: SDA/SCL levels per state and phase, bits shifted out and sampled in, bit count and completion
two-stage sampling of the SDA and SCL inputs
interrupt request when enabled, TX FIFO empty and engine idle; engine busy decision
status bits on a control read: sensed SCL and SDA, TX FIFO full, RX data available, busy
control settings and FIFO depth returned on a control read
received frame written to the RX FIFO on completion and returned on a data read, which pops the RX FIFO

rstn_i = '0' clears ctrl.enable, ctrl.prsc, ctrl.cdiv, irq_o, the tick counter, the phase generator, the engine registers and sets the SDA/SCL drive registers to '1' (ctrl.clkstr has no reset value); ctrl.enable = '0' clears both FIFOs, the tick counter, forces the phase generator to its start value and idles the engine
